issue.title: Saved capture templates (the Control-T template shelf)
issue.description: Every successful `@@template:` capture saves its template block to a bob-owned shelf on disk, and Bob Mac Capture's Control-T opens a stash-style shelf of those templates: picking one checks it out into the draft, capturing puts it back on top (with your edits), abandoning leaves it untouched, and nothing is ever silently lost.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/saved_capture_templates.md requests this work
